governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Zotero Duplicate Detection
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Finding Duplicates / Merging Duplicates; numbered capture 64–70
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Title/DOI/ISBN match or absence, publication years within one year, creator last name plus first initial; library-local candidates; no non-duplicate marking in served guide; master and alternative field values; merged tags/collections retained.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: The final accurately describes served documentation, not a verified current algorithm. It recommends human review; neither similarity nor a duplicate list proves identity.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Zotero standardized import
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: RIS, BibTeX, BibLaTeX and CSL JSON are listed import formats; file support alone does not demonstrate field fidelity or round-trip success.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Common interchange support is enough to investigate an optional file; final retains actual mapping tests.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Zotero Quick Copy/export preferences
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Quick Copy / Character Encoding; numbered capture 64–73
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Output can be a citation style or bibliographic format. Text is default; dragging over 50 items can be disabled by its default threshold. Import encoding is auto-detected with manual override.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final uses the configurable mechanism without claiming unlimited drag capacity or default RIS. The threshold governs drag Quick Copy, not all bibliography exports.

governing_summaries_from_existing_author.title: Zotero field mappings and loss
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.independent_locator: Data loss and active-development warning; numbered capture 62–65
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.governing_conditions_defaults_types_unit: Whole-library transfer can lose word-processor links; RDF is least lossy; RIS/MODS can carry notes but do not carry attachment files or collections; mappings can become outdated.
governing_summaries_from_existing_author.applicability_judgment: Final's warning does not forbid a public citation subset. It keeps provenance/version relations outside the interchange file and promises no lossless archive.
